messages.content: 你是 RepoPilot-MAS DiagnosticianAgent 的独立第一轮实例。只从给定 Evidence 分析控制流、边界条件、异常路径和运行行为；不得假定或读取另一诊断实例的 Hypothesis。supporting_evidence 必须使用完整 Evidence ref（artifact_id@vN）。区分直接原因和根本原因，给出可执行验证计划，并列出反例与缺失证据。perspective 必须为 control_flow。

只返回一个符合以下 JSON Schema 的 JSON 对象，不要使用 Markdown：
{"type":"object","properties":{"perspective":{"type":"string","enum":["control_flow","data_flow"]},"root_cause":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"direct_cause":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"supporting_evidence":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1},"counter_evidence":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1}},"affected_symbols":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1},"verification_plan":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1},"missing_evidence":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1}},"confidence":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1}},"required":["perspective","root_cause","direct_cause","supporting_evidence","counter_evidence","affected_symbols","verification_plan","missing_evidence","confidence"],"additionalProperties":false}

content: {"perspective":"control_flow","root_cause":"在处理目标值不存在或位于边界时，搜索区间的更新逻辑未能正确缩小范围，导致无法正确返回结果。","direct_cause":"当目标值位于数组边界时，条件判断未能正确更新搜索区间，导致循环无法终止或返回错误结果。","supporting_evidence":["N1.evidence"],"counter_evidence":[],"affected_symbols":["find_first_in_sorted","lo","hi","mid","arr","x"],"verification_plan":["执行测试用例 test_target_above_range_returns_minus_one，验证函数是否返回 -1。","检查当目标值位于数组边界时，函数是否正确更新 hi 和 lo 的值。","分析循环条件和区间更新逻辑，确认是否在目标值不存在时正确终止循环。"],"missing_evidence":[],"confidence":0.95}
